messages:
allegra: Quick heads-up — ran a small bring-up for caligo-compact-embed-v1 (fp16 -> int6 pipeline). Initial recall@10 on our short-query devset dropped from 0.72 -> 0.66. Not catastrophic but nontrivial.

sam: Thanks. Which quant path did you use? per-tensor or per-channel?

allegra: Per-tensor symmetric, calibration with 1k calibration samples (random short queries).

morgan: Can you paste the eval command you used?

allegra: Sure — ran locally with the eval harness:

```
./eval/run_sim_eval.sh --model caligo-compact-embed-v1 --quant int6 --calib-samples 1000 --batch 256 --k 10 --dataset shortquery-dev
```

jess: Any change in cosine distribution? median cosine drop?

allegra: Median cosine between fp16 vs int6 shifted -0.017, tail (5th pct) -0.04. Cluster silhouette for a small topic subset dropped from 0.34 -> 0.27.

kai: Those drops could explain recall hit. Did you try per-channel quant or a hybrid (per-channel for first/last layers)?

allegra: Not yet. Planning next run: per-channel with 2k calib + clip-aware range. Also will try keeping embedding norm layer in fp16 (hybrid).

sam: Also try rerunning with the same random seed and longer calibration (5k) — sometimes short calib skews scale.

morgan: FYI I pushed a quick visualization to the run artifacts: link -> https://artifacts.internal/runs/1757777777/tsne. Looks like two small clusters merge after int6.

jess: Could be a learned scaling in the last layer that gets crushed. For quick triage, run recall@100 as well — sometimes recall@10 suffers while recall@100 is stable, indicating local neighbor shuffles.

allegra: Ran recall@100 for same run: fp16 0.88 -> int6 0.85. So it's local neighbor reordering.

kai: Good signal. If recall@100 keeps most items, we may use int6 for cost-critical routes with fallback to fp16 for high-precision endpoints. Add a metric for "median rank change" per query.

allegra: Will add. Proposed next steps:
- per-channel int6 with 5k calib
- hybrid fp16 for final norm layer
- compute median-rank-change and recall@{1,5,10,100}
- run cluster silhouette on topic holdouts (3 topics, ~2k queries)

sam: Sounds right. Can you also run a small A/B eval against a staging reranker to see downstream rerank MRR?

allegra: Yep. I'll kick off jobs now (queue id 67241). ci-bot: start run 67241

ci-bot: Build queued (67241). Estimated ~18m. Logs: https://ci.internal/builds/67241

morgan: If that looks promising, we should test a routing policy that prefers int6 for non-critical routes and keeps a 5% fp16 sample for regression monitoring.

jess: Agreed. Also remind QA to add a few paraphrase-heavy queries (typos, code tokens) — quant can break rare-token geometry.

allegra: Noted. I'll attach a small paraphrase set to the job. Will report back with updated numbers and the tsne + silhouette plots.

sam: Thanks — ping here when done, and include the per-lang breakdown if you run multilingual samples.

allegra: Will do. End of mini thread.
